current_value: their analytic forms assume Gaussian spots; the implemented model contracts the exact pixel Jacobian instead
proposed_value: the implemented models use none of the paper's closed-form noise expressions, so none of the spot-shape (Gaussian or diffraction-limited) or field-of-view conditions of those expressions applies to them: detector.noise_model and detector.validity contract the exact per-pixel Jacobian of the plain centre of gravity over the declared finite window, which holds for any expected spot and makes the photon- and read-noise terms depend on the window through each pixel's lever arm

that a thresholded centre of gravity lies outside a first-order linear model is the repository's own rule (detector.noise_model reports it unsupported; detector.validity states that its first-order sigma does not cover it), not a quoted result of this paper
section, equation and appendix locators have not been checked in full text (access_note, revisions)

candidates.current_value: detector_covariance_v1 is supported for a plain centre of gravity without clipping, saturation, non-linearity or coarse quantization and with SNR_T >= 7; temporal sigma conditional on fixed masters gates validity, calibration-ensemble sigma is reported separately
candidates.proposed_value: detector_covariance_v2 (detector.noise_model.UNCERTAINTY_MODEL_ID) is supported only for a plain centre of gravity (no threshold, no minimum subtraction), without negative clipping or a declared non-linearity, with no expected saturation above 90 % of the pixel, EM-register or ADC capacity, with every block pixel's expected ADC code (bias and offset map included) at least 5 temporal noise sigmas inside both ADC limits, with read noise of at least half an ADC step on every pixel that enters the centroid (its own read-noise and gain maps, ADC on), with a positive window total and with SNR_T >= 7; its conditional mean, Jacobian, flux and SNRs subtract what the processing actually removes (the realized masters); the temporal sigma, conditional on those fixed masters, gates validity, and the calibration-ensemble sigma, linearized about the nominal background, is reported separately (centroid_calibration_sigma_px) as a persistent per-run bias
